title: Bluedot Phone Calls
lede: Bluedot, a meeting note taker that records without a bot joining the call, now records outbound phone calls placed from its web or mobile app and returns a transcript, summary and action items.

points: Users verify their number once, then dial from Bluedot so the other side sees their own caller ID.
Each call is recorded and transcribed, with a summary and action items ready once it ends.
Call notes land in the same workspace as notes from online and in-person meetings.
An optional announcement tells the other party the call is being recorded.
The team names two limits: outbound calls only for now, and a country list still being extended.

sections.text: People whose work runs over the phone, such as client follow-ups, candidate screens and supplier check-ins; commenters in sales are already asking for inbound calls.
